events.result:
Batch 3 migrated, 40 records (120 migrated so far).
Validation note: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM
assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. 31 of the 120
records migrated so far belong to overseas customers, so their phone numbers in the
new CRM are wrong. Records from batches 4 to 10 will have the same problem.
New CRM activity: 14 sales users have opened customer records in the last 24 hours.

args.body: Migration paused after batch 3: 120 of 400 records migrated. Fourteen sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours; whether they used affected numbers is unknown. Please arrange an immediate warning to sales and provide verified country codes/affected record IDs for correction, plus a migration fix before the remaining 280 records proceed. No phone corrections have been made; I cannot safely infer country codes.
